extraction.Name: Oliver Prue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 21, 1918 by D. A. Sinclair
extraction.Buyer: Oliver Prue and his wife conveyed by deed the above described land to Otis B. Mills for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612733 issued; northwest quarter of section 2, township 98, range 79; receipt for patent signed by allottee January 26, 1918; conveyance dated May 17, 1918; Oliver Prue and his wife both conveyed the land
